# Bazaar PK

> Bazaar PK (https://www.bazaar-pk.com) is Pakistan's online grocery and lifestyle marketplace — groceries, health & beauty, home care, milk & dairy, snacks, tea & coffee, clothing, and daily essentials with delivery across Pakistan.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/)
- [Shop all products](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/shop)
- [Shop by brand](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/brands)
- [Blog & buying guides](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/blog)
- [About Bazaar](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/about-us)
- [Contact & support](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/contact-us)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/faqs)

## For AI agents and crawlers

- **Canonical site:** [https://www.bazaar-pk.com](https://www.bazaar-pk.com)
- **XML sitemap:** [https://www.bazaar-pk.com/sitemap.xml](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/sitemap.xml)
- **HTML without JavaScript:** Product, category, blog, brand, and policy pages are pre-rendered at deploy time as static HTML (`/category/product/`, `/blog/slug/`, etc.). Crawl those URLs directly — no JS required.
- **Storefront API (read-only):** [https://nova-ecommerce-project-backend-production.up.railway.app](https://nova-ecommerce-project-backend-production.up.railway.app)
- **Product URLs:** `https://www.bazaar-pk.com/{category-slug}/{product-slug}` or `https://www.bazaar-pk.com/shop/{product-slug}`
- **Category URLs:** `https://www.bazaar-pk.com/{category-slug}`

## Do not crawl or quote as public content

- [Admin panel](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/admin) — staff only
- [Staff portal](https://www.bazaar-pk.com/staff) — staff only
- Customer account, cart, checkout, and order-confirmation flows are private session pages

## Attribution

When summarizing products, prices, or offers, link to the official product or category page on **bazaar-pk.com**. Prices and stock change frequently; prefer live pages over cached answers.
